verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Vanta automates audit prep, evidence collection, and offers an Auditor API/portal for auditors to pull data (vanta-docs-11, vanta-docs-29, vanta-docs-44), but nowhere does it show Vanta operates or markets a vetted auditor network, an in-house audit arm, or published booking/timeline expectations for founders to actually book an audit through Vanta itself.
